What are different models of plantation?
records.answer: We plan farms in 4 models: Commercial (Rows of main fruit trees with host timber and biomass plants between them); Food Forest (A layered 6 x 6 ft grid of canopy, sub-canopy, shrub and biomass plants, alternating rows for a self-feeding forest garden); Miyawaki (A dense native mini-forest on a 2 x 2 ft grid, about 3 plants per square metre); Boundary (A single line of trees along the farm boundary as a windbreak and living fence). The Help me choose planner lays out any of them for your land.
